patthana15.64:1.1: rūpāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na rūpāvacaro na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na rūpāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na rūpāvacaro na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. dve.
